'''Stormtrooper Force People SAGA''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Stormtrooper (GPN)|Stormtrooper]]
* '''Published:''' 3 February 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' Force People SAGA
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed FPS Stormtrooper LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Notes ==

* No objective and no starting cards are marked; the strategy section only says 'The srategy is very big but it come soon.'
* The draft parser dropped Combined Attack (Premiere Lost Interrupt, last in the Interrupts list) and read the 'Starfighter/Cruiser:' header as a card.
* Targeting Computer is posted under 'Effect' and Lightsaber Proficiency under 'Device'; the labels look swapped. Dested as posted (Targeting Computer is a Device, Lightsaber Proficiency an Effect).
* Posted 'TK-422(Solo)' dested TK-422 (Special Edition); 'Han With Heavy Blater Pistol' Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'X-wing Laser Canon' X-wing Laser Cannon; 'Qui-Gonn Jinn's Lightsaber' Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber.

== Strategy ==

The srategy is very big but it come soon.
